file_changes.reason: The jar now targets Java 21 (class file major 65) and would not start on a 17 runtime.

The requested Boot 4.1.1 / Java 21 target, walked as the ladder's three edges. · ChangeParentPom removed explicit versions that the new parent manages; on 4.x this would have moved only the core artifact to Testcontainers 2.0.5 while postgresql/junit-jupiter stayed 1.20.1. · The relocated slice annotations live in these modules; the composite's AddDependency(onlyIfUsing) proposed nothing, in rewrite-03 and again in the re-preview rewrite-04. · Boot 4 split the H2 console auto-configuration out of spring-boot-autoconfigure; application.yml still enables the console.

Jackson 3 mappers are immutable (no registerModule/disable/setDefaultPropertyInclusion on the instance), WRITE_DATES_AS_TIMESTAMPS moved to DateTimeFeature, java.time support is built in, and Boot 4's own @Primary JsonMapper backs off only for a bean typed JsonMapper. · Jackson 3 package root.
Boot 4 relocated the health contributor types.
Boot 4 removed @MockBean, moved the web slice to its own module, and ships Jackson 3.
Boot 4 moved the JPA slice to its own module.
